name: Finculator Cloud WAF Security Ruleset
description: Production edge WAF rules for Cloudflare and Vercel protecting against OWASP Top 10, automated credential stuffing, and bot scans.

rules.description: Block automated security scanners and exploit probes
rules.expression: (http.user_agent contains "sqlmap" or http.user_agent contains "nikto" or http.user_agent contains "acunetix" or http.user_agent contains "dirbuster" or http.user_agent contains "nessus" or http.user_agent contains "nmap" or http.user_agent contains "masscan")

rules.description: Cross-Site Tracing (XST) defense: block HTTP TRACE and TRACK methods
Rate limit authentication endpoints to prevent brute-force and credential stuffing
Rate limit generative AI query endpoint to prevent spend exhaustion and scraping
Defense-in-depth: Block direct web access to runtime data files or dotfiles
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/data/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/.env" or http.request.uri.path contains "/.git")
